source: Template table from the earlier research-deliverable summary of CHORDS.md. The full CHORDS.md (supplied 2026-10-07) does not carry this table, so these eight progressions are kept here as the only record of them; keys are read from each progression's first chord. The full document's method - voice leading, inversions, extensions, bass design - is in agent/prompts/chords.md and agent/src/chords.ts.

MT1.style: melodic techno: i - VII - VI - VII (MELODIC-TECHNO.md)

MT2.style: melodic techno: i(add9) - VImaj7 - III - VII(sus2)

MT3.style: melodic techno: tonic pedal under moving upper structures (MELODIC-TECHNO.md prefers this)

complexity_ladder_source: CHORDS.md 7, step 4: improve one dimension at a time, in this order, so it is clear which change helped. Replaces the three-step ladder taken from the earlier EDM-TIPS.md summary.

low_interval_limit.source: CHORDS.md 68 - a production heuristic, not an acoustics law: the lower the register, the wider the spacing should become. Bands are checked lowest first; a pair wider than every band passes.
